sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Continental Grafix AG is a leading manufacturer of one-way vision films, floor films, wall films, and printable media with 20 years of experience.

Industry: Manufacturing · Size: <$50M · Products: One Way Vision Films, Floor Films, Wall Films, Perforated Window Films, Non-Perforated Window Films, Floor and Wall Films

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Continental Grafix AG scores 16 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (12/30). Nothing was found for application fit, event engagement and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (33% similar on films, window, protection, fran); ORAFOL Europe (26% similar on films, information, digital, adhesive); Drytac (25% similar on films, media, wall, floor). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
